Maria Gonzales: Quick sync — I opened a tiny docs PR to add a concise style guide for function outputs (compact vs verbose). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
Devin Park: Nice. Can you add a note about SDK snippet parity? Our TS/py snippets must match the JSON examples. I'll add a PR comment.
Samir Patel: Re: parsing edge cases — we should call out optional arrays and nullable fields. Suggestion:
```json
{ "type": "object", "properties": { "result": { "oneOf": [ { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } }, { "type": "null" } ] } }, "required": ["result"] }
```
Kevin Liu: For TypeScript SDK, we should show `as const` examples and a tiny adapter snippet. I'll paste a quick example in the PR.
Devin Park: Also flag link fixes — the existing function calling page still points to the old `invoke` page. I'll add a note to replace with /function-calling/guide.
DocsBot: Reminder — update the docs index and run `yarn docs:build` after merging :robot_face:
Maria Gonzales: @Samir can you add one minimal + one expanded example in that schema block? Minimal = compact array, Expanded = envelope with metadata. Keep both under 40 lines.
Samir Patel: Added both examples to PR — minimal:
```json
["item1","item2"]
```
and expanded:
```json
{ "items": ["item1","item2"], "meta": { "source": "llm", "confidence": 0.87 } }
```
Kevin Liu: I pushed a TS snippet: `const out = parseResponse(json) // returns {items: string[], meta?: {...}}`
Devin Park: Leaving a tidy PR review now. LGTM on content, just one nit about wording in the gating paragraph.
Maria Gonzales: Awesome — assigning merge to @Kevin once PR is green. Thanks all :tada:
